topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Well, I'll be, the world sure turns in strange ways. Yesterday, Aelred came back from his journey to the town and he looked like a ghost had crossed his path. He went on about finding his old friend, a lad he'd known since his toddling days. Thought they'd share ale and tales like they used to, under the shade of the great oak. But when he spoke that friend's name, the man looked at him as if he were a stranger off the road. Can you imagine, all those years of sowing and reaping, laughing and crying, and to have it all be like water over stone? Aelred, he just smiled and said, "Best to plant new seeds where the soil is ready." But I saw in his eyes, the storm that was brewing. Some memories, they bind us tighter than a rope, and others, well, they just scatter with the wind.
